te: Petition on the issuing of a land title deed in Chon Buri Province: hearing the petitioner
se: The petitioner gave information and asked for a review of how the officials concerned performed their duties, and for a check of where the land with the title deed is located compared with the land under the original reservation certificate; if they do not match, the petitioner asked the Department of Lands to correct it. The meeting agreed to invite the Director-General of the Department of Lands, the Director-General of the Treasury Department, the Chon Buri Provincial Land Office, Phanat Nikhom Branch, and the Chon Buri Treasury Office to give information at the next meeting (the information is the petitioner's allegation; the subcommittee is fact-finding and this is not a conclusion)
it: Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province

te: Summary of the visit to the Lao Embassy and the study visit to Nakhon Phanom
se: The meeting considered the summary report of the courtesy call on the Ambassador of the Lao People's Democratic Republic to Thailand on taking up the post, and the discussion of cooperation between the two countries; the summary of the study visit to Nakhon Phanom; and a complaint about the issue of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri, which involves complex land document issues, so it agreed to invite the petitioner to give more information (the information is the petitioner's allegation; the subcommittee is fact-finding and this is not a conclusion)
it: Report on the courtesy call on the Ambassador of the Lao PDR to Thailand
Summary of the study visit on upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing
Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province

te: Schedule of the study visit to the relaxed trade point, Nakhon Phanom
se: The meeting considered the schedule of the study visit to Nakhon Phanom on 27–28 November 2025: meetings with the provincial governor, district chiefs, state agencies, the private sector and the public on legal rules and criteria, transport and economic readiness, security readiness, value for money and impacts, and problems and obstacles, together with visits to the Ban That Phanom and Ban Phaeng relaxed trade points
it: Study visit on upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing

te: Prepared observations on the Ban Phaeng relaxed trade point for the National Security Council
se: The meeting prepared observations and suggestions on upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing, for the National Security Council to use in its consideration on 20 November 2025, and scheduled a call on the Ambassador of the Lao People's Democratic Republic to Thailand before the study visit to Nakhon Phanom on 27–28 November 2025
it: Upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing
Call on the Ambassador of the Lao PDR to Thailand

te: Heard from agencies on upgrading the Ban Phaeng relaxed trade point to a permanent border crossing
se: Senators and representatives of the Ministry of Interior, the National Security Council, the Department of Foreign Trade, the Customs Department, the Immigration Bureau, the Department of East Asian Affairs, the Deputy Governor of Nakhon Phanom and the Ban Phaeng District Chief exchanged views on the approaches, problems and obstacles in upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing. The meeting resolved to gather observations from the agencies as information for the subcommittee that considers opening, suspending or closing border crossings (National Security Council)
it: Upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, to a permanent border crossing

te: Meeting with agencies on a factory's air treatment system, Rayong
se: Representatives of the Department of Industrial Works, the Rayong Provincial Industry Office, the Pollution Control Department, the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning, the Thai Industrial Standards Institute and the petitioner's representatives met to go over the criteria and approaches for bringing the air treatment system into line with the law. The petitioner's representatives said they had made the improvements as ordered and had applied to the Department of Industrial Works for permission to test the system. The meeting asked the agencies concerned to carry out integrated checks together. In another matter, the state agency that received a complaint about a restaurant rent increase has sent a letter to the subcommittee explaining the facts
it: A complaint from a private company in Rayong that was ordered to stop operating its factory, on the request for permission to test its air treatment system and the system's design (exhaust stack)
Complaint seeking fairness over a rent increase for a food and drink shop in a state agency
